determinism: the three generated artifacts are a pure function of exporter + input-manifest + canonical + html-shell bytes

assuranceModel.contentBoundary: structural tree projection over parsed data — every top-level branch classified exactly once, projection rebuilt from the included set
assuranceModel.chrome: typed plain text, HTML-escaped by the exporter, exact output reviewed
assuranceModel.shell: one exact pinned + reviewed input; the SHA detects movement, it does not make alternate bytes trusted. Editing the shell and updating its pin creates a NEW review candidate
assuranceModel.postimageConformance: HARD fail-closed assertions over the exact admitted shell transformation; NOT a security sandbox and NOT proof about an arbitrarily edited + re-pinned shell
assuranceModel.excludedTermChecking: LINT only — not a security boundary, not a semantic non-disclosure proof, not proof about browser-visible text
assuranceModel.filesystem: fixed filenames, in-memory generation, fresh staging directory, exclusive no-clobber writes
